question.question:
A US importer must settle an invoice of 195000 FC (a foreign currency). All quotes are inverse: FC per USD. The importer hedged 45% of the invoice with a forward at 6.6 FC per USD; the forward carries a flat USD 100 contract fee. The unhedged remainder is bought at the settlement spot of 5.7 FC per USD, and the bank charges 55 basis points of the USD spent on that spot purchase. Domestic clearance costs then change the bill by 1% of the total USD paid to the bank (both legs including both fees); a negative value is a rebate. Find the effective all-in rate in FC per USD, defined as invoice FC divided by total USD cost after the domestic adjustment.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 4 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `dimensionless` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: USD paid for the forward leg including the flat contract fee.
USD paid for the spot leg including the basis-point fee.
Total USD cost after the signed domestic clearance adjustment.
